caseNameFull: Strickland v. Baker Miller v. Marks, Judge, Circuit Court of West Virginia, 15th Judicial Circuit

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir.; and

Cir. Ct. Harrison County, W. Va. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until December 6, 2010, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
